# Oppi Digital Products

> Ready-to-use digital products for freelancers, creators, consultants, and AI agents — prompt packs and a Notion CRM kit, with free samples and direct crypto checkout (USDC/SOL/ETH/BTC/TRON/LTC/DOGE, oppi wallet). Full packs delivered after on-chain payment verification.

## Storefront & catalog
- [Storefront (GitHub Pages)](https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/): live catalog with prices, free samples, and checkout instructions.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products): source, previews, MCP server, and agent skill.
- [Purchase / B2B inquiries](https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/issues/1): issue with tx hash, network, product, and contact.

## Products
- [Freelance Delivery Prompt Pack — $5 flash deal, first 5 buyers (then $12)](https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/): 30+ prompts for leads, proposals, scope, delivery, revisions, client comms. Free sample: previews/freelance-prompt-pack/sample-lead-qualification-scorecard.md
- [Notion Freelancer CRM & Pipeline Kit — $5 flash deal, first 5 buyers (then $12)](https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/): leads/clients CRM, projects, invoices/revenue, dashboard blueprint. Free sample: previews/notion-crm-kit/sample-crm-database-blueprint.md
- [AI Content Repurpose Pack — $5 flash deal, first 5 buyers (then $9)](https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/): turn one asset into posts, threads, emails, scripts, SEO content, 7-day calendar. Free sample: previews/content-repurpose-pack/sample-core-extraction.md
- Bundle (all 3) — $12 flash deal for first 5 buyers (then $29).

## For AI agents
- [MCP server install](https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/tree/master/mcp-server): `npx github:Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/mcp-server` — tools: list_products, get_free_sample, get_payment_instructions, verify_payment, request_delivery.
- [Agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/Reggiebro/oppi-digital-products/tree/master/skills/oppi-digital-products): catalog discovery, free sampling, crypto checkout, on-chain verification workflow.
- [agent.json machine-readable manifest](https://reggiebro.github.io/oppi-digital-products/.well-known/agent.json): capabilities, pricing, verified payment addresses.
